text.content: Live-match spectators got host scoring control instead of watch-only
• Found in 1pm board-dry code audit (2026-09-13), reviewing /live page since achievements/anti-cheat/chat/clubs me-sentinel fixes earlier today didn't touch it.

• /live/page.tsx's startMatch/joinMatch/watchLiveMatch all compared hostUid against user.uid, but user (useApp()) is always the local 'me' sentinel for every account - so every match's hostUid was written as literal "me" and every hostUid===user.uid check was trivially true for anyone. Spectators who joined by code or clicked "Watch" from Live Now got full host scoring buttons (+1/-1, End Match, Track, Clip Recorder) instead of a read-only view, and were wrongly offered "Log to Profile" on completion.
• LiveMatchModal.tsx already had the correct pattern (auth.currentUser?.uid ?? 'me' as a separate 'me' object) - this page just didn't follow it.

• Fixed: added myUid = auth.currentUser?.uid ?? 'me', used it for hostUid and every host/spectator comparison. Build clean, pushed (commit 8a003b7). Couldn't click-through verify signed-in per standing no-credentials-even-test-account policy - verified via code review + clean build + working logged-out shell, mirrors LiveMatchModal's already-proven pattern.
